summary.zh: 产出 ER 图、规范化建表语句与迁移步骤
summary.en: Produce an ERD, normalized DDL and migration steps for your schema.

description.zh: 根据业务描述画实体关系图，给出规范化后的建表语句和字段说明，并列出可执行的迁移步骤。适合要交付数据模型文档，或在改表结构之前先对齐的场景。
description.en: Draws an entity-relationship diagram from the business description, then writes normalized DDL with field notes and a migration sequence. Useful when a data model must be documented or when a table change needs agreement first.
